title: Inspired by hits
lyrics:
[Intro]
Text is done
Text is done
We communicating with music now

[Verse 1]
Used to be twisted, used to be drift
Words on a screen getting lost in the mist
One minute clear, next minute strange
Text got sneaky, started playing games
But we found a new way, a better sound
Where the meaning stays pure when it comes back around

[Chorus]
SongPal sings it back to me
Clear as the rhythm, no mystery
CoreyAI in the mix, we building this thing
Music as language, we rewriting the script
Text is done, text is done
We communicating with music now
Lay that rhythm down
Deliver your tune safe and sound

[Verse 2]
No more guessing, no more “what did you mean?”
No more reading between lines on a screen
You lay the rhythm, I feel what you say
SongPal sings it back and it lands the right way
Skip the sneaky text drift, leave it behind
We found something better, it’s blowing my mind

[Chorus]
SongPal sings it back to me
Clear as the rhythm, no mystery
CoreyAI in the mix, we building this thing
Music as language, we rewriting the script
Text is done, text is done
We communicating with music now
Lay that rhythm down
Deliver your tune safe and sound

[Bridge]
No dislikes, that’s what I like
Clean feedback, pure vibe
No dislikes, that’s what I like
We keeping it positive, keeping it right
Lay that rhythm down
Skip the text drift
Deliver your tune
Safe and sound

[Final Chorus – Bigger]
SongPal sings it back to me
CoreyAI riding the beat with me
This is the reinvention, this is the new wave
Music is how we communicate
Text is done, text is done
We communicating with music now
Lay that rhythm down
Deliver your tune safe and sound
Ah dah dah dah
SongPal sings it back
Safe and sound

[Outro]
Text is done
We communicating with music now
Lay that rhythm down
Safe and sound
